seoTitle: USPR Cirillico · Football for Russian speakers in Turin
seoDescription: USPR Cirillico is a men's and women's football team in Turin for students, refugees and emigrants from the former USSR. A ConVoglio ONLUS project.
subtitle: RUSSIAN-SPEAKERS SPORTS UNION
lead: A team against war: here friendship is stronger than any conflict.
heroImageAlt: The USPR Cirillico team on the pitch
whoLead: Young women and men from the former Soviet Union countries who live in Turin. The team is open to anyone who shares our ethical guidelines.

groups.title: Ukrainian refugees
groups.text: Who came to Turin after the war broke out.

groups.title: Young Moldovans
groups.text: Who came to Italy to work.

storyTitle: From a neighbourhood tournament to the newspapers.

timeline.text: The group forms to play at Balon Mundial, Turin's tournament of communities.
With the war in Ukraine the team becomes an example of integration, covered by Italian and international media.
Friendly match with ASD San Paolo Torino.

joinText: Fill in the form and we'll get back to you with training days and times.
footer: USPR Cirillico is a project of ConVoglio ONLUS
